name: kajo-downloader
description: Kajo Downloader — free desktop app to download a single video, a playlist, or an entire channel (Electron, yt-dlp)
author: Adam Refaey

scripts.typecheck: tsgo --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --composite false && tsgo --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false
scripts.check: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip && pnpm run check:i18n && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run check:compiler
scripts.test:e2e:planned: echo "Playwright E2E smoke not implemented yet — see scripts/e2e-smoke.md" && exit 1
scripts.start: pnpm run rebuild:natives && node scripts/ensure-dev-binaries.mjs && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/with-env.mjs electron-vite preview
scripts.dev: pnpm run rebuild:natives && node scripts/ensure-dev-binaries.mjs && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/with-env.mjs electron-vite dev
scripts.build: pnpm run rebuild:natives && node scripts/with-env.mjs electron-vite build
scripts.binaries:mac: pnpm run binaries:mac:x64 && pnpm run binaries:mac:arm64
scripts.binaries:win: pnpm run binaries:win:x64 && pnpm run binaries:win:arm64
scripts.binaries:linux: pnpm run binaries:linux:x64 && pnpm run binaries:linux:arm64
scripts.build:unpack: pnpm run build && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --dir
scripts.build:win:x64: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:win:x64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --win --x64
scripts.build:win:arm64: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:win:arm64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --win --arm64
scripts.build:win: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:win && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --win --x64 --arm64
scripts.build:mac:x64: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:mac:x64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --mac --x64
scripts.build:mac:arm64: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:mac:arm64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --mac --arm64
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:mac && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --mac --x64 --arm64
scripts.build:linux:x64:deb: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:linux:x64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --linux deb --x64
scripts.build:linux:x64:rpm: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:linux:x64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --linux rpm --x64
scripts.build:linux:x64:appimage: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:linux:x64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --linux AppImage --x64
scripts.build:linux:arm64:deb: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:linux:arm64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --linux deb --arm64
scripts.build:linux:arm64:rpm: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:linux:arm64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --linux rpm --arm64
scripts.build:linux:arm64:appimage: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:linux:arm64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --linux AppImage --arm64
scripts.build:linux:x64: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:linux:x64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --linux deb rpm AppImage --x64
scripts.build:linux:arm64: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:linux:arm64 && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --linux deb rpm AppImage --arm64
scripts.build:linux: pnpm run build && pnpm run binaries:linux && pnpm run electron-builder:with-env -- --linux deb rpm AppImage --x64 --arm64
